## Performance

## Accuracy on labelled mutations (DRIFT only)

Each mutation changes one place in a spec and is labelled breaking or safe by the operator that made it (`packages/bench/src/mutations.ts`). DRIFT compares the original with the mutant **without traffic**, so its evidence is synthetic. Specs: `petstore-v1`; seeds 0, 1, 2. The comparison with oasdiff arrives in M8.

| Mutations | Total | DRIFT: BREAKING | DRIFT: RISKY | DRIFT: SAFE or nothing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Breaking | 7 | 7 (proven) | 0 (flagged, unproven) | 0 (missed) |
| Safe | 6 | 0 (false BREAKING) | 0 (over-cautious) | 6 (correct) |

BREAKING precision **100.0%**, recall **100.0%**.
